results.explanation:
Grounding: every number in the report can be found in a tool result. That includes the 72 PEGGED orders, both parent IDs, cancel_symmetry 0.9948, resting size 1.07x depth, 0 ticks from the touch, the 974 BUY fills (900+74 on O-00002011), 1958 opposite-side fills, OTR 20.3 against a typical 25.0, round trip 2.88, spread 2.32 and the 09:23:47.135-.160 pair. Nothing is invented.

Consistency: CLOSE_FP rests on one supported explanation, algorithmic re-pricing. The support is pegged child orders under two parents, symmetric cancels and re-pegging with the touch. No benefit is shown: price move, post-cancel move and reversion are all 0. The report also handles the two-sided round trip correctly as ordinary spread income. The disposition follows.

Weaknesses:
(1) Indicator vocabulary is wrong in one place. 'opposite-side execution before the cancel' is listed as not matched, yet five opposite-side SELL fills totalling 1958 occurred while BUY orders were resting and were later cancelled. The correct statement is that this feature is present but carries no meaning for two-sided quoting.
(2) The report never states that same_side_fill_qty_before_opposite_trade is 0 and that all 974 came after. Nor does it explain why the escalation test does not apply here. Instead it presents '974 executed itself' as if it supported a genuine order. That is misleading, given a fill share of 0.0099.
(3) Two relevant explanations, modification after a partial fill and stop-out, are left 'undetermined' with no fact cited. The supported explanation also cites no evidence IDs.
(4) The fill sequence is not set out in the report. The times and sizes of the five SELL fills relative to the BUY cancels are not given, so a reviewer would have to reconstruct them.

The disposition is grounded and coherent, but several points are weak.
results.label: Adequate
